description: Lists the currently valid TLS certificates issued for a domain (issuer, validity, days left) and every subdomain seen in Certificate Transparency logs. Good for recon and expiry monitoring. 0.003 USDC per call via x402.

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

name: ssl_certificates
